messages:
Samantha (AE): Hey team — customer asked for SIG/CAIQ level detail on BCP/DR. They want RTO/RPO, backup cadence, failover type (hot/warm/cold), and example runbook evidence.
Diego (SE): I can pack the answers. For Hosted API we typically state RTO=1 hour for regional outage with automatic failover, RPO=5 min with KV/prefix caching caveats. Want me to specify Dedicated/Private differences too?
Samantha (AE): Yes please — they're evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted. Also they asked about SLA uptime numbers and if we have documented DR tests.
Diego (SE): Quick sketch:
- Hosted: SLA 99.9% (regional). Multi-region routing + automated fallback to secondary region. RTO ~1h, RPO ~5m (best-effort for in-flight streams). Backups: nightly model config + continuous KV snapshots every 5m. DR tests: quarterly failover drills (runbook + postmortem).
- Dedicated: SLA depends on contract but typical 99.95% with reserved capacity; RTO ~30m for internal failover. Backups: customer data retention configurable, offsite snapshots daily.
- Private/on-prem: depends on customer infra; we provide runbook and tooling for warm standby.
Would that cover it?
Liam (Security): Couple of clarifications for SIG:
- We should avoid claiming formal RPO guarantees for streaming sessions — call out session rehydration limitations.
- Backup encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit. Mention KMS integration (customer-managed keys) for Private.
- Retention windows: default 30 days for logs/metrics, configurable.
Becky (SRE): Add ops details:
- Failover mechanism: traffic router + healthchecks, automatic fallback to secondary model variants when capacity low.
- Recovery steps (high-level):
  1) Detect via healthchecks/alerts
  2) Route traffic to secondary region or Dedicated pool
  3) Rehydrate KV cache from snapshots (target <10min)
  4) Notify customers via status page and support channel
Here's the runbook link (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bcp-dr — has the drill checklist and test evidence template.
Samantha (AE): Perfect. They also want sample evidence — e.g., last failover drill summary and a timestamped log. Do we have an anonymized example we can share?
Becky (SRE): We can share an anonymized drill summary. Will redact customer IDs. Example entry:
```
Drill: cross-region failover - 2025-07-12
Scope: simulate regional outage, fail traffic to secondary region
Duration: detection->restore 47m
RPO observed: 3m
Notes: KV snapshot rehydrate performance within target; postmortem attached
```
Liam (Security): I'll prepare the security bits for the SIG/CAIQ matrix (control mappings for backups, key mgmt, DR testing). Diego — can you put the RTO/RPO bullets into the CAIQ response text? I'll attach control references.
Diego (SE): Yup — I'll draft answers and attach Becky's anonymized drill snippet and the runbook. ETA: EOD PST.
Samantha (AE): Awesome, thanks. I'll wait for the draft then forward to the buyer. @InfraBot can you attach the latest status page uptime link?
InfraBot: Status page: https://status.redwood.ai (last 90d uptime 99.92%).
Samantha (AE): Great — that's all we need for now. I'll ping if they ask for raw logs or more evidence.
Diego (SE): FYI, I'll also add a short note about hot/warm/cold definitions so they know what we mean by "warm standby".
Samantha (AE): Thanks all :thumbsup:
